nodes.label: instructor/__init__.py
nodes.desc: Package facade. Lazy _LAZY_IMPORTS table surfaces Instructor, AsyncInstructor, from_openai, from_provider, patch, Mode and the DSL without importing providers upfront.

nodes.label: core.client shim
nodes.desc: Compatibility shim: star re-exports the v2-owned client wrappers so the historical instructor.core paths keep working.

nodes.label: Instructor
nodes.desc: Instructor (sync) wrapper: holds create_fn, mode, provider and hooks; create() accepts response_model and returns a validated Pydantic model.

nodes.label: AsyncInstructor
nodes.desc: AsyncInstructor subclass: awaitable create/create_with_completion plus async partial and iterable streaming.

nodes.label: patch()
nodes.desc: patch()/patch_v2() wrap a client's chat.completions.create (or any callable) with schema injection, templating, caching and retry support.

nodes.label: Mode enum
nodes.desc: Mode enum: TOOLS, JSON, TOOLS_STRICT plus Anthropic/Gemini/Mistral/Cohere and other provider-specific strategies.

nodes.label: ModeRegistry
nodes.desc: ModeRegistry maps (Provider, Mode) tuples to ModeHandlers bundles (request_handler, reask_handler, response_parser) with lazy loading.

nodes.label: from_openai
nodes.desc: from_openai builds Instructor or AsyncInstructor from an OpenAI (or OpenAI-compatible) client; also powers anyscale/together/databricks/deepseek.

nodes.label: from_anthropic
nodes.desc: from_anthropic builds Instructor/AsyncInstructor from an Anthropic client using ANTHROPIC_TOOLS or ANTHROPIC_JSON modes.

nodes.label: from_provider
nodes.desc: from_provider('openai/gpt-4o') splits the provider/model string, installs the right SDK client and hands back a ready Instructor.

nodes.label: retry_sync_v2
nodes.desc: retry_sync_v2/retry_async_v2: tenacity-driven chain that parses, validates, accumulates token usage and reasks the model with the validation error.

nodes.label: process_response
nodes.desc: process_response dispatches a raw completion to the right parser and returns the validated model with _raw_response attached.
